ai_summary: Ducon Infratechnologies Limited has received trading approval from both NSE and BSE for 249,942,759 new equity shares issued at Re. 1.00 each via a rights issue, with trading commencing on September 17, 2026, and no lock-in period. This transaction injects approximately Rs. 25 crore into the company but represents significant dilution for existing shareholders who did not participate due to the substantial increase in the outstanding share count at a nominal value.
